lines.text: God gives a man riches, wealth, and honor, but a stranger enjoys them instead of him.
A man with a hundred children and many years is unsatisfied, and the Teacher says a lonely foreigner is better off.

wrong_details.wrong: a lonely foreigner is better off
wrong_details.true: a stillborn child is better off

lines.text: The stillborn child never sees the sun, yet has more rest than the man, even if he lived two thousand years.
All a man's labor is for his mouth, and his appetite is filled by hard work.

wrong_details.wrong: his appetite is filled by hard work

lines.text: Man cannot contend with one stronger than he, and no one can tell him what will come after him under the sun.
